parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 10 to 500. Default value: If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than 10, the default value is 10. If the value is greater than 500, the default value is 500.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the previous API call. For more information about how to view the returned data, see the operation description above.

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:
- CREATED: The task is created.
- RUNNING: The task is running.
- COMPLETE: The task is completed successfully.
- FAILED: The task failed.
- EXPIRED: The task has expired.
- CANCELED: The task has been canceled.
